Towers will also have ghosts appear out of them. |ability1_cooldown = 45 |ability1_starting_cooldown = 5 |ability2 = '''Summon''' - Summons in five [[Enigma (Nil Zone)|Enigmas]] with a 0.3 delay, ten [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2s]] with a 0.8 delay and five [[Unknown Boss]]es with a 0.8 delay between each one, while also healing itself by 1,000 health. |ability2_cooldown = 35 |ability2_starting_cooldown = 20 |ability3 = '''Void Smash''' - Slams its club around itself, creating purple thorns that stun any tower they hit for 4 seconds. |ability3_cooldown = 38 |ability3_starting_cooldown = 5 |music-1 = }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Conserver''' was the final boss of [[Nil Zone]] as part of the first [[Halloween 2025 Live Events|Halloween 2025 Live Event]]. It can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It had a high amount of health though it walked quite slowly. It was also a [[Boss]] enemy, granting it multiple immunities, making it significantly harder to slow down. The '''Conserver''' has three abilities. Its first ability is ''Spirit Release'', which makes it fire out multiple skulls from its body. These stun towers for 3 seconds while also applying a 40% [[Scared Debuff]] for 10 seconds. Towers will also have ghosts appear out of them. The second ability is ''Summon'', which summons five [[Enigma (Nil Zone)|Enigmas]] with a 0.3 delay between each, ten [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2s]] with a 0.8 delay and five [[Unknown Boss]]es with a 0.8 delay, while also healing itself by 1,000. Its last ability, ''Void Smash'' makes it slam its club on the ground, creating multiple thorns that stun any tower hit for 4 seconds. == Appearance == The '''Corrupted Conserver's''' body is made entirely out of what appears to be purple molten slag or lava. It wears black armor, which covers most of its body. Its helmet has multiple horns. Additionally, it has spikes seen around its head that resemble teeth. It wields a black club with neon purple insides, which has three eyes on it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. **High range towers that cannot be stunned like the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are also useful, as they can attack the '''Corrupted Conserver''' at all times while also being mostly unaffected by its [[Scared Debuff]]. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at providing boosts to your towers. **The [[Medic]] can be used to shield your towers from stuns, but it cannot be used to shield them from the [[Scared Debuff]]. It can also provide boosts to towers it shields. *The '''Corrupted Conserver's''' ''Summon'' ability will summon in high numbers of enemies, which due to them at best being 25% of the '''Corrupted Conserver's''' health can easily overwhelm your defenses. **AOE towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be helpful, though do note that the ability contains [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2s]] which are immune to [[Splash Damage]]. **Stalling towers can be helpful as the enemies summoned on top of being quite strong are way faster than the '''Corrupted Conserver'''. Such towers include the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Toxic Gunner]]. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:ConserverDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Corrupted Conserver''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCorruptedConserver.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, death animation (4 October 2025 – Present) CorpseCorruptedConserverStandUp.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, standing (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CorruptedConserverIconIG.png|'''Corrupted Conserver''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Corrupted Conserver''' has one of the strongest summons in the entire game, as they have a total health of 273,500 with [[Defense]] and the healing of the ability accounted for, but not [[Enigma (Nil Zone)|Enigma]]'s summons. **If [[Enigma (Nil Zone)|Enigma]] summons are accounted for, the lowest possible value is five [[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1s]] without [[Bloated]] or [[Health Regen]], which increases it to 288,500, while the highest is five [[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3s]] with [[Bloated]], which increases it to 473,500. ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' - [[V1.76.0|v1.76.2b]] **'''Corrupted Conserver''' added. *'''4 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.2d]] **'''Corrupted Conserver''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{AdminAbuseLiveEvent|[[Enigma (Nil Zone)|Enigma]]|Wave 14|[[Unknown Boss]] & Corrupted Conserver|Wave 15|End|N/A|date = 4 October 2025}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Corrupted Conserver}} [[Category:Bosses]]
